name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs and python-dotenv packages, created the example script, and generated a valid MP3 audio file (output.mp3, 43KB, MPEG ADTS layer III, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, monaural) from the text "The first move is what sets everything in motion." using the George voice (JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb) and the eleven_v3 model.
deviations: The quickstart's example code calls `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers. Since the sandbox is a headless environment with no audio output hardware, I replaced the `play(audio)` call with code that writes the audio stream to a file (`output.mp3`). The core API authentication and text-to-speech generation code matches the quickstart exactly.
